title: CartridgeFlow Protocol Library
description: Local read-only browser for the authoritative protocol knowledge base.

protocol-source.description: Authoritative current and temp-runtime protocol artifacts, releases, outlines and governance metadata.

protocol_catalog.title: Protocol catalog
protocol_catalog.description: Browse releases. Leave source_id empty to show both protocol lines.
protocol_catalog.sql: select source_id, protocol_id, version, name, category, lifecycle, specification_status, implementation_status, runtime_adapter, artifact_count from protocol_release_overview where (:source_id = '' or source_id = :source_id) order by source_id, protocol_id, version

read_protocol.title: Read protocol documents
read_protocol.description: Enter a protocol id such as CF-FARP. Source, version and artifact path are optional refinements.
read_protocol.sql: select source_id, protocol_id, version, artifact_path, content as content_markdown from protocol_document where protocol_id = :protocol_id and (:source_id = '' or source_id = :source_id) and (:version = '' or version = :version) and (:artifact_path = '' or artifact_path = :artifact_path) order by source_id, version, artifact_path

search_protocols.title: Search protocol sections
search_protocols.description: Search headings and Markdown section content. Leave source_id empty to search both lines.
search_protocols.sql: select section.source_id, release.protocol_id, release.version, section.artifact_path, section.heading, section.line_start, section.line_end, section.content as content_markdown from section_fts as section left join protocol_release as release on release.release_key = section.release_key where :query != '' and (:source_id = '' or section.source_id = :source_id) and (instr(lower(section.heading), lower(:query)) > 0 or instr(lower(section.content), lower(:query)) > 0) order by section.source_id, release.protocol_id, release.version, section.artifact_path, section.line_start limit 200

source_overview.description: Responsibility boundary and aggregate counts for each protocol line.

protocol_release_overview.description: Queryable release catalog for both protocol lines.

protocol_document.description: Complete protocol artifacts projected as readable text.

protocol_outline.description: Heading-level document navigation with source line numbers.
